answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the grove queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 435 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. The glacier index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 90 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
